payload.reason: The evidence provides clear descriptions of the use of question generation models in frameworks that involve question answering and knowledge-based reasoning tasks.

claims.text: A question generation model is used in frameworks that integrate question answering and knowledge extraction from documents and external knowledge bases.
The model generates questions based on the semantics of candidate answers, facilitating machine reading comprehension tasks.
The question generation model employs a sequence to sequence architecture to effectively generate questions from input facts.
